5.16
Grounded Prompt Builder
After retrieving relevant chunks, the Prompt Builder constructs a grounded prompt for
the Large Language Model.
The prompt contains:
• System Instructions
• Retrieved Context
• Source Information
• User Question
The prompt explicitly instructs the language model to answer only from the supplied
context and avoid using external knowledge.
This strategy minimizes hallucination and improves answer reliability.
5.17
Retrieval-Augmented Generation Engine
The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine combines semantic retrieval with a
local Large Language Model.
The implemented workflow is:
1. Receive Question
2. Retrieve Relevant Chunks
3. Build Grounded Prompt
4. Send Prompt to Ollama
5. Generate AI Response
6. Generate Citations
7. Return Final Answer
The project uses the locally deployed Llama 3 model through the Ollama framework.
Local execution improves privacy since uploaded research documents never leave the
user’s computer.
